descriptionEs: Abrir ayuda para la palabra clave
explanation: Opens the built-in help documentation for the given keyword.
Saves the current buffer to a new file with the specified name.
Closes the currently active window or split pane.
Opens a built-in terminal emulator within Vim.

descriptionEn: Open man page for word under the cursor
descriptionEs: Abrir página man para la palabra bajo el cursor
explanation: Looks up the manual page for the keyword under the cursor.
Moves the cursor one character to the left.
Moves the cursor one line down.
Moves the cursor one line up.
Moves the cursor one character to the right.
Moves cursor down by display line (useful for wrapped lines).
Moves cursor up by display line (useful for wrapped lines).

descriptionEs: Mover al inicio de la pantalla
explanation: Moves cursor to the top line of the current viewport.

descriptionEs: Mover a la mitad de la pantalla
explanation: Moves cursor to the middle line of the current viewport.

descriptionEs: Mover al final de la pantalla
explanation: Moves cursor to the bottom line of the current viewport.

descriptionEn: Jump forwards to the start of a word
descriptionEs: Saltar adelante al inicio de una palabra
explanation: Moves to the beginning of the next word.

descriptionEn: Jump forwards to the start of a word (words can contain punctuation)
descriptionEs: Saltar adelante al inicio de una palabra (incluye puntuación)
explanation: Moves to the beginning of the next WORD (bounded by whitespace).

descriptionEn: Jump forwards to the end of a word
descriptionEs: Saltar adelante al final de una palabra
explanation: Moves to the end of the current or next word.

descriptionEn: Jump forwards to the end of a word (words can contain punctuation)
descriptionEs: Saltar adelante al final de una palabra (incluye puntuación)
explanation: Moves to the end of the current or next WORD (bounded by whitespace).

descriptionEn: Jump backwards to the start of a word
descriptionEs: Saltar atrás al inicio de una palabra
explanation: Moves to the beginning of the previous word.

descriptionEn: Jump backwards to the start of a word (words can contain punctuation)
descriptionEs: Saltar atrás al inicio de una palabra (incluye puntuación)
explanation: Moves to the beginning of the previous WORD (bounded by whitespace).
Jumps between matching parentheses, brackets, or braces.

descriptionEn: Jump to the start of the line
descriptionEs: Saltar al inicio de la línea
explanation: Moves to the very first character of the line.

descriptionEn: Jump to the first non-blank character of the line
descriptionEs: Saltar al primer carácter no vacío de la línea
explanation: Moves to the first visible character on the line, ignoring whitespace.

descriptionEn: Jump to the end of the line
descriptionEs: Saltar al final de la línea
explanation: Moves to the last character of the line.

descriptionEn: Go to the first line of the document
descriptionEs: Ir a la primera línea del documento
explanation: Jumps to the very top of the file.

descriptionEn: Go to the last line of the document
descriptionEs: Ir a la última línea del documento
explanation: Jumps to the very bottom of the file.
Enters insert mode before the current character.

descriptionEn: Insert at the beginning of the line
descriptionEs: Insertar al inicio de la línea
explanation: Enters insert mode at the first non-blank character of the line.
Enters insert mode after the current character.

descriptionEn: Insert (append) at the end of the line
descriptionEs: Insertar (anexar) al final de la línea
explanation: Enters insert mode at the end of the current line.
Opens a new line below the current one and enters insert mode.
Opens a new line above the current one and enters insert mode.
Returns to normal mode.
Replaces the character under the cursor with the next keystroke.
Enters replace mode, overwriting characters until Esc is pressed.
Undoes the last change.
Redoes the last undone change.
Selects text character by character.
Selects text line by line.
Selects text in a rectangular block.
Indents the selected text.
De-indents the selected text.
Copies the selection to the register.
Deletes (cuts) the selection.
Copies the entire current line.
Pastes content from the register after the cursor.
Pastes content from the register before the cursor.
Deletes the entire current line.
Search forward for the specified string or regex.
Search backward for the specified string or regex.

descriptionEs: Repetir búsqueda en la misma dirección
explanation: Jumps to the next occurrence of the search pattern.
Jumps to the previous occurrence of the search pattern.
Saves changes to the file.
Saves the file and closes the window.
Discards changes and closes the window.

descriptionEs: Aumentar la altura de la ventana actual
explanation: Resizes the current split window, increasing its height by one line.

descriptionEs: Disminuir la altura de la ventana actual
explanation: Resizes the current split window, decreasing its height by one line.

descriptionEs: Aumentar el ancho de la ventana actual
explanation: Resizes the current split window, increasing its width by one column.

descriptionEs: Disminuir el ancho de la ventana actual
explanation: Resizes the current split window, decreasing its width by one column.
Maps Ctrl+w then w to just Ctrl+w, effectively starting a window command and waiting for the next key (h/j/k/l, etc.).

descriptionEn: Move cursor left in insert mode
descriptionEs: Mover el cursor a la izquierda en modo inserción
explanation: Moves the cursor one character to the left without leaving insert mode.

descriptionEn: Move cursor right in insert mode
descriptionEs: Mover el cursor a la derecha en modo inserción
explanation: Moves the cursor one character to the right without leaving insert mode.

descriptionEn: Move cursor down in insert mode
descriptionEs: Mover el cursor hacia abajo en modo inserción
explanation: Moves the cursor one line down without leaving insert mode.

descriptionEn: Move cursor up in insert mode
descriptionEs: Mover el cursor hacia arriba en modo inserción
explanation: Moves the cursor one line up without leaving insert mode.
Writes the current buffer to disk, equivalent to :w.
Temporarily leaves insert mode, saves the file with :w, and returns to insert mode.

descriptionEs: Salir de la ventana actual (modo normal)
explanation: Quits the current window, equivalent to :q.

descriptionEs: Salir de la ventana actual (modo inserción)
explanation: Temporarily leaves insert mode, quits the window with :q, and returns to insert mode (though the window is closed).
When the popup completion menu is visible, moves to the next suggestion; otherwise inserts a Tab character.
When the popup completion menu is visible, moves to the previous suggestion; otherwise inserts Shift+Tab.
When the popup completion menu is visible, accepts the selected suggestion; otherwise inserts a normal newline.
Opens or closes the NERDTree file explorer.
Another shortcut to open or close the NERDTree file explorer.
Calls CocActionAsync('doHover') to show LSP hover information (type, documentation) for the symbol under the cursor, overriding the default man-page K behavior.
Starts visual-multi: adds a cursor on the word under the cursor. Press again to add cursors on the next occurrences of the same word.
Starts adding new cursors on the lines below, skipping empty lines, letting you edit multiple lines at once.
Starts adding new cursors on the lines above, skipping empty lines, for multi-line editing.

descriptionEn: Start multi-cursor selection to the right
descriptionEs: Iniciar selección multicursor hacia la derecha
explanation: Begins selecting text to the right with multiple cursors, similar to extending a selection horizontally.

descriptionEn: Start multi-cursor selection to the left
descriptionEs: Iniciar selección multicursor hacia la izquierda
explanation: Begins selecting text to the left with multiple cursors, useful for editing columns of text.

descriptionEs: Seleccionar todas las ocurrencias en el archivo
explanation: Uses vim-visual-multi’s leader key (by default \\) and A to select all occurrences of the current word in the entire file.
Starts a visual-multi regex search so you can place cursors on matches of a pattern.

descriptionEs: Añadir cursor en la posición actual
explanation: Places an additional cursor at the current position without selecting a word, giving fine-grained multi-cursor control.

descriptionEn: Add visual selection as multi-cursor region
descriptionEs: Añadir selección visual como región multicursor
explanation: In visual mode, turns the current selection into a multi-cursor region and lets you jump to other occurrences.
